text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, during a strategy meeting for our next race.
choice_data_list: I've prepared the list of runners right here, so—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...Tree kangaroo-san, that's not a tree, that's a high-rise apart...ment...
...Mnya."
choice_data_list: ...Just what kind of dream are you having?
...Just what kind of dream are you having?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Regardless of what she dreamed, she must be tired enough
to doze off like that. I might need to
re-evaluate her schedule...
